title: Replace ActiveX Controls
problem_statement: The application uses deprecated ActiveX controls which are not supported in modern environments.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of unsupported controls may lead to security vulnerabilities and compatibility issues.
suggested_approach: Identify equivalent .NET controls and refactor the application to use these instead.
success_criteria: All ActiveX controls are replaced with .NET equivalents.
The application functions correctly without ActiveX dependencies.
